exposure: Time interval between cancer diagnosis and pregnancy
cohort: The study included the first child (N = 8031) of female cancer survivors aged < 40 years (excluding thyroid cancer survivors) and 24,093 matched controls, born between 2005 and 2019.
finding: Offspring born to maternal cancer survivors had an increased risk of cancer (HR = 1.91, 95% CI = 1.07-3.38) compared to controls.
followup_time: At least 2.0 years (mean age of cancer diagnosis in offspring)
